Name: Victy's Seasonal Outfits - Compatible with SVE
Author: ahomiepassingby
Description:
If you know the beautiful mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28217]Victy's Seasonal Outfits[/url] and are in love with it, but when using it with SVE, some portraits didn't work.
[left][size=5][b]Then I'm here to fix that! 🔥
[/b][/size]﻿[/left][b]About this mod:[/b]
I created seasonal Gunther, Marlon, Morris, and Wizard portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197324612]Yumi0224[/url] for Vanilla's version. It's the matching outfits as the original, so my mod almost has no difference. [size=3]Except Wizard! [/size][size=2]I'm in love with Wizard under [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/V1cty?gameId=1303]V1cty[/url]'s touch. Therefore, Wizard on my mod is an old-handsome-long-haired man.
[/size]I also plan to make all versions of Victy's Wizard (young-long-haired, young-short-haired, maybe possibly having-bearded version but maybe not). Just give me some time to work on it.

[b]How to install:[/b]
Just like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28217]Victy's Seasonal Outfits[/url], mine also only contains PNG images. I already created a folder with the same name as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] for you, so you can directly replace it in StardewValley/Mods (or where your [i][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE[/i] is), avoiding exhaustion from clicking 🤭

[b]Note:
[/b]If you want a synchronized gaming experience, you should replace my Wizard portraits in the vanilla mod, too!

[b]Thanks:[/b]
Original artist: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/V1cty?gameId=1303]V1cty[/url]/[url=https://m.cafe.naver.com/ca-fe/web/cafes/28468938/articles/436635?tc=cafe_member_profile]Vicky[/url] for gorgeous art!
Author: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197324612]Yumi0224[/url] for making Victy's portraits seasonal and allowing me to modify her work.
And [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url], 'cause I've picked up her flower for Wizard on his Flower Dance outfit 🌸

Nếu bạn biết đến/dùng mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28217]Victy's Seasonal Outfits[/url] và có cài cả bản SVE mà portrait của Gunther, Marlon, Morris, and Wizard bị lỗi/không hoạt động.

[b][size=4]Thì mod này sẽ sửa nó! ✨
[/size][/b]
Mình sửa portrait của các nhân vật Gunther, Marlon, Morris, and Wizard trong SVE để trải nghiệm game được đồng bộ. Hầu hết các nhân vật đều giống như portrait vanilla của [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197324612]Yumi0224[/url], [b]trừ Wizard[/b]! Mình khá thích phong cách người đàn ông trung tuổi do [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/V1cty?gameId=1303]V1cty[/url] vẽ, nên mod này mình dùng portrait đấy để làm.

Ngoài ra Victy còn có các portrait phù thủy khác (trẻ tuổi tóc dài, trẻ tuổi tóc ngắn, và phiên bản có râu), dự kiến mình sẽ làm trong tương lai.

[b]Cách cài:[/b]
Mod chỉ bao gồm ảnh. Và để giúp mọi người tránh rườm rà phải bấm nhiều thì mình có lập nguyên cái folder to trùng tên với folder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] (chỉ bao gồm file ảnh của mình) để mọi người replace cho dễ. 

[b]Lưu ý:[/b]
Khuyến nghị nên replace file ảnh của Wizard bên mod vanilla.

Tác giả mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28217]Victy's Seasonal Outfits[/url]: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197324612]Yumi0224[/url], vì đã dành thời gian và tâm huyết để tạo ra những bộ trang phục tuyệt đẹp.
Tác giả mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url], vì mình đã hái hoa của cô ấy để cài lên cho Wizard vào Lễ hội hoa 🤭
